# TemporaryDirectoryHandle

A temporary directory that owns its name.

```rux
pub struct TemporaryDirectoryHandle {
    // private fields
}
```

Move-only, with the same contract as [`TemporaryFile`](/docs/api/filesystem/temporary-file): [`Close`](/docs/api/filesystem/temporary-directory-handle#close) removes it and reports, destruction removes it
quietly, [`Keep`](/docs/api/filesystem/temporary-directory-handle#keep) gives up ownership. Removal is of the directory itself and requires it to be empty — nothing
here deletes a tree, because a temporary directory that silently erased whatever a caller put inside it
would be a worse surprise than a refusal.

## Associated functions

<h3 id="create"><code>Create</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Create(allocator: Allocator, directory: Path, prefix: char8[..]) -> TemporaryDirectoryHandle ! IoError
```

Creates a new temporary directory in `directory`, named from `prefix` and sixteen hex digits of entropy.

| Name        | Type        | Description                             |
| ----------- | ----------- | --------------------------------------- |
| `allocator` | `Allocator` | where the storage comes from            |
| `directory` | `Path`      | the directory to create it in           |
| `prefix`    | `char8[..]` | the text the generated name starts with |

**Returns**: the created directory, which is removed when closed unless kept

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/FileSystem/Src/Temporary.rux#L202)

## Destructor

```rux
func ~TemporaryDirectoryHandle(self: &var TemporaryDirectoryHandle)
```

Removes the directory with the outcome discarded: the safety net, not the contract.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/FileSystem/Src/Temporary.rux#L254)
